title: The Copper Regiment
author: Casper Sterling
blurb: Silas Lockridge, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
